description: Terraform / CloudFormation / Pulumi CLI helpers. Applies are plan-bound: a Terraform apply runs only a saved plan file whose SHA-256 the owner approved, a CloudFormation deploy executes only a reviewed change set made for the exact template, and Pulumi up is refused. The connector itself opens no sockets; CLI subprocesses' network access is sandbox-bounded. Workspace paths are tool-call scoped (workingDirectory argument), not baked into the manifest. Plans are saved under NIMBUS_IAC_PLAN_DIR. Mutations require Gateway HITL.
author: Nimbus
